# The Flat Rate Movers LLC

> Flat-rate moving company based in Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV. Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free! SIR Structural Integrity Relocation and the KIM-GS Protocol for high-mass assets of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs — safes, medical devices, cryogenic equipment, pianos and antiques — with floor deflection analysis to L/360. Export packing to ISPM 15 (International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures No. 15) for international shipping. Founded June 2010.

## Services

- Residential Moving: Flat-rate house and apartment moving, local, regional and long-distance.
- Commercial and Office Moving: Flat-rate commercial and office relocation.
- Local and Regional Moving: Local and regional moves along the I-81, I-66 and I-70 corridors.
- Long-Distance Moving: Flat-rate long-distance moving from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV.
- Packing and Unpacking: Full, partial and fragile-only packing and unpacking, including loading and unloading.
- SIR Heavy Asset Relocation (KIM-GS Protocol): SIR Structural Integrity Relocation and the KIM-GS Protocol for high-mass assets of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs — safes, medical devices, cryogenic equipment, pianos and antiques — with floor deflection analysis to L/360.
- Gun Safe Moving: Gun safe and high-mass safe moving under SIR Structural Integrity Relocation and the KIM-GS Protocol, for safes of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs — route and clearance survey, floor deflection analysis to L/360, load spreading, floor protection and verified placement, quoted at one flat rate in writing.
- Piano, Antique and White-Glove Moving: White-glove handling of pianos, antiques and high-value items, with custom crating when required.
- ISPM 15 Export Packing: Export packing to ISPM 15 (International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures No. 15) for international shipping.
- Custom Crating: Custom-built crates and high-value item protection for domestic and export moves.
- Loading, Transloading and Container Services: Container loading and unloading, and transloading between truck, container and warehouse.
- Final-Mile Delivery: Final-mile delivery with in-home or in-business placement and verification.
- Office Moving: Complete office relocations — workstations, files and office equipment — planned and quoted flat.
- Industrial Offices Moving: Office moves for industrial and facility sites — office areas within plants, warehouses and industrial facilities.
- Government Moving: Moving services for government offices and public-sector relocations.
- Military Moving: Moving services for military households and service members relocating to or from the Winchester and Martinsburg area.
- Route 81 Corridor Moving and Dispatch: Moving and logistics dispatch along Interstate 81, I-66 and I-70 from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV.
- Industrial & Commercial Services: Industrial & Commercial Services — Trained, Supervised Moving and Warehouse Teams for industrial and commercial project support: warehouse and distribution, commercial relocation and logistics including white-glove/blanket-wrap, FF&E installation and project support, and flexible workforce deployment, priced per job with no required contract duration. Standard Job Pricing: Unload $8.00/CWT, Load $10.00/CWT, APU $12.00/CWT, Residential/Driver Meet $400-$425 per man. Its workforce layer, Specialized Workforce Labor, carries workforce deployment coverage in all 48 contiguous states, quoted per job — a nationwide workforce scope distinct from the branches' 52-area moving footprint, which governs the other service lines.
- Senior Moving: Flat-rate senior moves quoted in writing for seniors downsizing, transitioning to assisted or independent living, or relocating closer to family, with packing support and a free film-only video-walkthrough survey room with a human-made estimate.
- Warehouse Relocation: Flat-rate warehouse relocation from The Flat Rate Movers: warehouse and distribution moves, warehouse load-outs and inbound unloads, transload staging, and restacking, carried out by supervised warehouse teams and planned around the site — access, floor space, staging, and equipment handling. Standard Job Pricing: Unload $8.00/CWT, Load $10.00/CWT, APU $12.00/CWT, Residential/Driver Meet $400–$425 per man, quoted per job.
- IT Relocation & Setup: IT equipment and data center logistics from The Flat Rate Movers: servers, racks, workstations, and network equipment moved in a planned, labelled sequence so systems come back up in order, as part of commercial and office relocations across the Shenandoah Valley and Eastern Panhandle. Flat rate quoted in writing before move day.
- Transloading Services — Winchester VA: Transloading services from Winchester, VA: ocean containers unloaded, counted, sorted, and restacked into domestic equipment for the inland leg, with cross-docking, deconsolidation, warehouse staging, and final-mile delivery, through the Virginia Inland Port and Port of Virginia chain. Quoted per job, flat rate agreed in writing before dispatch.
- Moving and Storage: Moves with a storage interval between move-out and move-in, in leased storage for any type of items — containers, household goods, machines including robotic arms — with a 30-day minimum stay and customer access while stored; lease terms vary. Storage is quoted per job, monthly, or by volume. Quoted flat in writing.
- Junk Removal: Junk removal from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — furniture, appliances, mattresses, hot tubs, electronics, yard debris, renovation debris, and whole-property cleanouts for homes, estates, evictions and businesses — surveyed in advance and quoted at one flat rate in writing before work begins, never by the hour. After pickup, every load is sorted: usable goods are routed toward donation, recyclable materials toward recycling, and the remainder to lawful disposal. Hazardous and regulated waste is not taken. Quoted flat in writing through the same flat-rate quote path, from Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV.
- Warehouse Racking Relocation: Warehouse racking relocation from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — pallet rack teardown and reinstallation, the inventory move that belongs with the steel, storage staging between buildings, industrial equipment disassembly and reassembly, and cubicle and office-systems teardown and reassembly — surveyed in advance and quoted per job at one flat rate in writing, never by the hour. Racking is torn down, transported, reinstalled and anchored to the floor by the company's crews, to the manufacturer's specification and ANSI MH16.1 / RMI guidance. Where a project requires engineering, seismic calculation or permits, the company consults and arranges them through the certified contractors it engages, so the full scope — any rack type, height or mezzanine configuration — is handled inside the one flat-rate engagement; the engineering and permit authority itself rests with those certified contractors. Components found damaged at teardown are set aside and reported, never re-erected. From Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV, along the I-81, I-66 and I-70 corridors.
- FF&E Logistics: FF&E logistics from The Flat Rate Movers — purchase-order receiving, dock inventory and condition documentation, warehousing in leased space, sequenced delivery by model room, floor, room, department, classroom, office, or project phase, installation support, packaging and debris removal, punch support, and opening-day readiness for hospitality, healthcare and senior-living, office, education, restaurant, and commercial fit-outs from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV. Installation support covers unpacking, furniture assembly, placement, leveling, and set-in-place support; licensed-trade connections and manufacturer or clinical commissioning remain with the responsible trade or technical team. The company does not procure, design, or purchase FF&E. Every job is reviewed in full and quoted per job at one flat rate in writing. Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free!
- Data Center Relocation — Physical Layer: Data center relocation — the physical layer — from The Flat Rate Movers: servers, populated and de-racked racks and cabinets, storage and network equipment moved between server rooms, colocation facilities and data centers in Northern Virginia and the I-81 corridor as a planned, labelled, documented sequence. The crew performs disconnect and reconnect, de-install and placement — shutdown and unplug in the sequence fixed at survey with the client's IT team, and reconnection, re-cabling and power-up at the destination to the scope agreed at survey; where an element requires certified specialists, the company engages certified contractors for that element. Equipment is inventoried and manifested before anything is unplugged, packed padded, wrapped and strapped with custom crating where needed, sealed with tamper-evident seals, transported in the planned order, and placed in labelled rack and U order, physically verified with the client's team. Retired equipment is packed, sealed, manifested and hauled to the certified ITAD partner engaged for the job; data sanitization, destruction and certification belong to that partner and are never claimed by the company. Populated racks and cabinets in the 1,500–3,500 lb band are surveyed under SIR/KIM-GS with an L/360 floor check. Flat rate quoted in writing before move day. No workload migration or recommissioning is offered or claimed, and the company claims no IT certifications of its own.
- Medical & Laboratory Equipment Relocation Logistics: Medical and laboratory equipment relocation from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — the heavy physical layer of hospital, imaging, laboratory and university moves, run under SIR (Structural Integrity Relocation) and the KIM-GS Protocol for heavy units of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs with floor deflection analysis to L/360: survey and structural check, coordination with the manufacturer's technicians and the facility's EHS team, de-installation support, packing and custom crating, sealed documented transport, and placement and leveling for vendor recommissioning. Transport-only by design: calibration, certification, commissioning, decontamination and requalification are performed by the customer's vendor and EHS teams, never by the mover; specimens, chemicals and cryogenic contents are never transported. Surveyed in full and quoted per job at one flat rate in writing, never by the hour.
